name: hengmu
description: Knowledge-backed architecture audits, solution decisions, verification, remediation, portfolio governance, and trustworthy deterministic gates for Codex.

interface.longDescription: Audit repositories and portfolios, verify evidence and provenance, compare architecture and technology options, record decisions, plan migrations, maintain sourced knowledge, benchmark behavior, and enforce trusted findings with layered deterministic policy. Local helpers require Python 3.11–3.13 with PyYAML and jsonschema.
defaultPrompt: Audit this repository and verify every architecture finding.
Compare architecture options and record an evidence-backed decision.
Run the layered architecture gate on the latest trusted review.
